correctness.rationale: For odd m>=5 with 3 not dividing m and b>=2, the maximum graph distance in C_m square C_{2b} is D=(m-1)/2+b. Exact forbidden pairs at inclusive threshold D-1 are (x,y) to (x±(m-1)/2,y+b). These form b disjoint induced cycles C_{2m} because gcd((m-1)/2,m)=1, so the Rips complex is a b-fold join of Ind(C_{2m}). The cycle independence theorem gives one sphere S^{q-1}, q=2 floor(m/3)+1 odd; its join is S^{bq-1}. On the primitive integral top class factor exchanges contribute (-1)^{q^2}=-1. The frozen derivation uses signed augmented Lefschetz traces on the canonical cycle factors for r,s and the induced factor permutation/half-turn for t,u, yielding exact signs r=+1, s=epsilon_m^b, t=(-1)^b, u=(-1)^{floor(b/2)}, epsilon_m=+1 for m mod6=1 and -1 for m mod6=5. I independently built all maximal-distance forbidden edges and components and computed signed fixed-face alternating traces for eight parameter pairs (5,2),(5,3),(5,4),(5,5),(7,2),(7,3),(7,4),(11,2), including b=4; all four signs agreed. Such finite tests corroborate but do not establish the infinite sign formulas. Rational transfer for the finite factorwise dihedral quotient identifies its positive-degree rational homology with invariants; r,s,t,u all positive precisely for b multiple of 4, since q odd. The original source proves the general statement using factor Lefschetz and join permutation signs.
